scenes.vo: Teens, you're wasting your peak growth years.
Three daily habits unlock your full height.
First, sleep nine hours to decompress your spine.
Second, sprint and jump daily for bone strength.
Third, ditch morning sugar for a high-protein breakfast.
And there's way more inside our app. Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
